scope: Internal bearer request-to-principal adapter with injected external trusted verifier, server-owned identity resolution, revocation check and R26 membership adapter call. No HTTP endpoint, JWT cryptographic implementation, provider, real DB, RLS, MFA, client content or deployment.

tests.notes: Tests added first; import fails before session module.
Synthetic fake verifier and membership DB-API result sets; node --check UI also passed.
Malformed/missing bearer and long/multitoken headers rejected before verifier.
Trusted callback result required; issuer/audience/subject, issued/not-before/expiry evaluated.
Server authority maps external identity to internal principal, not directly from token subject.
Session status rechecked for every call, including case of cryptographically valid but revoked session.
Verifier, identity store, session store errors suppressed from response.
Authenticated principal passed to R26 DB membership adapter; target tenant rechecked, old document/chat context reset.
Actual OIDC/SAML/JWT signature verification, keys, rotation, provider policy.
Persistent session DB, MFA/step-up, logout, token rotation, concurrent revocation.
Approved HTTP handler and true 401/403/404 behavior, browser/cross-tenant E2E.
PostgreSQL migrations, FORCE RLS, tenant and document ACL at point of use.
No app staging or production runtime deployed.

trust_contract: Token verifier MUST be an independently vetted trusted server dependency and return VerifiedBearerIdentity only after cryptographic verification. Mock verified identity in tests is not a security proof. Session and principal lookup are server-owned.
srs_owner_decisions: D01 remains PENDING_APPROVAL; not silently closed.
